description:
Resolve Git merge conflicts in the 'commons-inventory' project. A merge of 'main' into 'feature/discount-system' has resulted in conflicts in 4 files:

1. Product.java: Keep BOTH the new 'category' field (from main) and 'discountPercent' field (from feature), and ensure toString() includes both.
2. InventoryManager.java: Keep the Streams-based refactoring of calculateTotalValue() (from main) AND the new calculateDiscountedTotal() method (from feature).
3. InventoryUtils.java: Keep BOTH the formatCurrency() and calculateBulkDiscount() methods.
4. pom.xml: Keep BOTH commons-lang3 and commons-math3 dependencies.

After resolving conflicts, commit the merge and ensure the project compiles successfully using Maven.
